title: Charity — note regarding Savoy sufferers
text: Charity.— There is, perhaps, not another town it the state, whose citizens are more charitably disposed than are those of Brenham, but it seems they are a little dilitory in duty towards the Savoy sufferers, as we have heard of no move being made towards procuring funds for their relief. Who will take the lead in this matter?
notes: Brenham Weekly Banner, Vol. 15, No. 23, Ed. 1, Friday, June 4, 1880. Short editorial note calling on Brenham citizens to raise funds for victims of the Savoy disaster (the 1880 cyclone). Spelling 'dilitory' (for 'dilatory') is original.
